name: escalation-playbook
description: De-escalate a customer crisis using a structured acknowledge-triage-DRI-cadence-resolution framework. Use when user says "customer escalation", "angry customer", "exec escalation", "customer threatening to leave", "fire drill", "critical customer issue", "customer is livid", "customer complaint escalated", or "how do I handle this" about a tense situation - even if they don't say "escalation" explicitly. Applies to CSMs and CS managers managing high-stakes customer crises.
